sourceBackedExpansionBoundary.invariant: dividend = divisor * quotient + remainder AND 0 <= remainder < divisor
mustCoverQuotientDigitCases: 3-digit quotient when the first two dividend digits are sufficient for the divisor
2-digit quotient when the first two dividend digits are insufficient for the divisor

adjacentBoundaries.P1-08: owns the canonical two-/three-digit-dividend two-digit-divisor stage and is the required predecessor; P1-09 increases dividend digits without minting a new KP
adjacentBoundaries.P1-10: owns three-digit divisors; P1-09 divisor remains exactly two digits
adjacentBoundaries.P1-11: owns explicit remainder/checking emphasis; P1-09 may return quotient and remainder but does not teach checking or remainder-context interpretation
